Bill.BriefDescription: Restricting utility assessments and charges for certain mobile home parks.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to restricting utility assessments and charges forcertain mobile home parks; and amending RCW 35.67.370.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 35.67.370 and 1998 c 61 s 1 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Cities, towns, or counties may not require existing mobile homeparks to replace existing, functional septic systems with a sewersystem within the community unless the local board of health determinesthat the septic system is failing. (2) Cities, towns, counties, local improvement districts, utilitylocal improvement districts, municipal corporations, politicalsubdivisions, or any other persons, firms, or corporations areprohibited from requiring existing mobile home parks to pay a utilityassessment, connection charge, or any other charge associated with autility until the mobile home park connects to that utility. This actis remedial in nature and applies retroactively.
